facts.fact: The Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research reports that on 20 October 2026 the fifth multisectoral meeting split the tasks for a language model specialised in Algerian tax legislation with the Directorate General of Taxes, with equipment provided and a four-month delivery deadline.
